# Fremont Dispatch

> The Fremont Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Fremont, CA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Fremont](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Standards](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Ardenwood](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/ardenwood/): North Fremont along Ardenwood Boulevard and Paseo Padre Parkway, with Ardenwood Historic Farm and the Coyote Hills Regional Park entrance on Patterson Ranch Road.
- [Centerville](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/centerville/): The historic business district on Fremont Boulevard near Thornton Avenue and Peralta Boulevard, with the Centerville Train Depot for Capitol Corridor and ACE trains and the Centerville Library on Nicolet Avenue.
- [Niles](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/niles/): The historic district along Niles Boulevard at the Fremont end of Niles Canyon, with the Niles Essanay Silent Film Museum, the Niles Canyon Railway station on Mission Boulevard and the Niles Library on I Street.
- [Downtown](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/downtown/): Fremont's downtown along Capitol Avenue, between Mowry Avenue, Walnut Avenue, Paseo Padre Parkway and Fremont Boulevard, with City Hall and the Downtown Event Center and its plaza.
- [Central Fremont](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/central/): The city's center around Central Park and Lake Elizabeth, bordered by Stevenson Boulevard and Paseo Padre Parkway, with the Fremont Main Library and the Fremont BART station on BART Way.
- [Irvington](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/irvington/): The district around Five Corners, where Fremont and Washington boulevards meet Union and Bay streets, and the planned Irvington BART station at Washington Boulevard and Osgood Road.
- [Mission San Jose](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/mission-san-jose/): The historic district around Old Mission San Jose at Mission and Washington boulevards, with Ohlone College and the Mission Peak Regional Preserve trailheads off Mission Boulevard and Stanford Avenue.
- [Warm Springs](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/warm-springs/): South Fremont around the Warm Springs/South Fremont BART station on Warm Springs Boulevard, the Warm Springs Innovation District and Warm Springs Community Center park.
- [Pacific Commons and the Baylands](https://www.fremontdispatch.com/pacific-commons/): The bayside area along Auto Mall Parkway and Cushing Parkway, with Pacific Commons Sports Park at the end of Auto Mall Parkway toward the Baylands and the Don Edwards San Francisco Bay National Wildlife Refuge.
